title: leontodon microcephalus
intro: Leontodon microcephalus, commonly known as small-headed hawk's beard, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and is believed to aid in the treatment of digestive issues and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Leontodon microcephalus include soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and acting as an expectorant to ease respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of Leontodon microcephalus include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
